scripts.dev: npm run build -w @portfolio/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @portfolio/shared" "npm run dev -w @portfolio/api" "npm run dev -w @portfolio/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @portfolio/shared && npm run build -w @portfolio/api && npm run build -w @portfolio/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start -w @portfolio/api" "npm run start -w @portfolio/web"
scripts.lint: eslint packages/shared/src packages/shared/tests apps/api/src apps/api/tests scripts && npm run lint -w @portfolio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/shared && npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/api && npm run typecheck -w @portfolio/web
